SELECT wt.id, wt.instance_id AS instanceId, wi.process_key AS processKey, wi.process_name AS processName, wi.title, wi.business_key AS businessKey, wi.current_node AS currentNode, wt.task_name AS taskName, wt.arrive_time AS arriveTime, su.nickname AS startUserNickname FROM wf_task wt JOIN wf_instance wi ON wt.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON wi.create_by = su.id WHERE wt.del_flag = '0' AND wi.del_flag = '0' AND wt.assignee_id = #{userId} AND wt.status = 1
AND ( wi.title LIKE #{request.keyword} OR wi.process_name LIKE #{request.keyword} )
ORDER BY wt.arrive_time DESC

SELECT wt.id, wt.instance_id AS instanceId, wi.process_key AS processKey, wi.process_name AS processName, wi.title, wi.business_key AS businessKey, wi.current_node AS currentNode, wt.task_name AS taskName, wt.arrive_time AS arriveTime, wt.handle_time AS handleTime, wt.action, wt.comment, su.nickname AS startUserNickname FROM wf_task wt JOIN wf_instance wi ON wt.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON wi.create_by = su.id WHERE wt.del_flag = '0' AND wi.del_flag = '0' AND wt.assignee_id = #{userId} AND wt.status = 2
AND ( wi.title LIKE #{request.keyword} OR wi.process_name LIKE #{request.keyword} )
ORDER BY wt.handle_time DESC
